proof_summary: Introduce an auxiliary sequence with \(b_0=2\), \(b_1=56\), and \(b_{n+2}=-4b_{n+1}-64b_n\). A simultaneous induction on a four-term window proves \(a_{2n+1}=b_n^2\), \(a_{2n+2}=b_nb_{n+1}+64^{n+1}\), \(a_{2n+3}=b_{n+1}^2\), and \(a_{2n+4}=b_{n+1}b_{n+2}+64^{n+2}\); substituting both recurrences advances the window by two terms and yields the square identity.
